plus.analyst_notes:
Closes https://github.com/vz-risk/VCDB/issues/24556
Victim: Hollys (South Korean coffee chain, about 530 outlets, owned by KG Group). NAICS changed from 7224 (Drinking Places, Alcoholic Beverages) to 722515 (Snack and Nonalcoholic Beverage Bars) because Hollys is a coffee-shop chain.
Template Hacking-ext-unknown used: external actor, hacking variety Unknown. Deviations: vector Unknown (not Web application) and asset S - Unknown (not S - Web application), because sources say only 'unauthorized access to a cloud service used for membership information' / 'membership program system' with no entry point; cloud coded External Cloud Asset(s) since the data sat in a cloud service.
Possible cryptomining: Chosun Biz (issue comment) says the actor is 'presumed' to have accessed the system to mine cryptocurrency; shattered.io says this is being examined but unconfirmed. Not coded (no malware action) because it is not established; reviewer may add malware Cryptocurrency mining if confirmed.
Data: user IDs and passwords (Credentials; storage/hashing of passwords not disclosed, so state Stored), names, dates of birth, phone numbers, addresses, emails, DI identity-verification value (Personal). 2.76 million is a count of records/'pieces of personal information' from cumulative 2009-Feb 2020 signups, likely with duplicates, not unique people; used as amount and data_total with that caveat. Hollys says these were temporary files from a past membership-service overhaul that should have been deleted (regulators examining retention); no Error action coded because retention failure is not an overt action that caused the breach.
data_disclosure Yes: unauthorized access to the system holding the data is confirmed; Yonhap says hackers 'stole' the data, but exfiltration volume is not confirmed, so result is Infiltrate only.
Timeline: access window Sept 3 - Oct 7, 2026; incident coded 2026-09-03; detected by Hollys Oct 7 (about 5 weeks); disclosed Oct 19. discovery_method internal Unknown (Hollys detected it; method not stated). dbir_year 2027.
Actor variety/motive Unknown (no group named, no ransom/sale). Employee count Unknown: no headcount found (many outlets are franchised).
Sources: shattered.io (issue) and Korea Times (issue comment) read; Yonhap and Chosun Biz (issue comments) were blocked, their content taken from the comment text.
Confidence Medium: reputable sources, but action variety, vector and actor unknown.

event_chain.summary: Unauthorized access to cloud membership data

summary: South Korean coffee chain Hollys disclosed on Oct 19, 2026 that an unauthorized party accessed a cloud service holding membership data between Sept 3 and Oct 7, 2026, exposing about 2.76 million customer records (user IDs, passwords, names, dates of birth, phone numbers, addresses, emails and identity-verification DI values) from signups between 2009 and February 2020. The data sat in temporary files left from a past membership-system overhaul. Hollys detected the access on Oct 7, blocked it, reported to KISA and ordered password resets.
